generated_background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Civilization VI mod static leader diplomacy and loading-screen background, wide landscape composition approximately 2:1, ideally 2048x1024. Input image is a style and palette reference ONLY for the existing Vivhite / Baiqi character: match its cool silver-white, midnight blue, violet gemstone, subtle gold accents and delicate blue butterfly motif; do not draw the character. Primary request: an elegant independent painted magical backdrop suitable behind a layered leader portrait and game UI. Scene: a restrained midnight-blue-to-indigo magical space with soft distant architectural arches suggested in shadow, a few fine gold celestial geometric lines, small sparse cyan butterfly-shaped lights and violet glints around the outer right-hand edge. Composition: left third very quiet and dark enough for UI text, middle-right region broad low-detail negative space so the existing bright silver-haired character can be layered on top; ornament concentrated at far edges with depth and atmospheric perspective. Refined anime game illustration, crisp tasteful detail only near edges, gentle lighting, coherent softly painted environment, no overpowering glow. Constraints: background only, fully opaque, landscape, edge-to-edge complete scene, no people, no human silhouettes, no portrait, no character, no weapons, no interface frame, no lettering, no labels, no runic text, no logos, no watermark. This is a single standalone background, not a sprite sheet, not a collage, not a character redesign.
